name: Elf no Ohime-sama ~Kozukuri Rankou de haramasete!~
original_name: エルフのお姫様～子づくり乱交で孕ませてっ！～
source:
One day, Princess Julia watches a traditional ritual. There she finds her mother having sex with some young soldiers. Julia is confused at first, but it is an official ritual which has been handed down for generations.... As Julia has sex with soldiers every day, she gradually gets to know the pleasure of having sex....
